cosmetic: The top tab strip is cut off at the right edge (the last tab shows only 'Dec…'). It looks like a horizontally scrollable tab bar, but nothing on screen shows that it scrolls.

The secondary text is small and low-contrast grey on the dark background: the note paths under 'Based on 3 notes', the run timestamps and the 'Checked against 27 saved cases' footers. It is readable, but faint.
Long lines in the Routing diff blocks wrap onto several lines, so the diffs are harder to scan, though no text is lost.
Under 'Schedule and jobs', the 'Save schedule and jobs' button looks greyed out and blends into the panel. It is probably disabled until something changes, which is fine, but it is easy to miss.
